node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double quadratic-quotient weld
node.statement: Modulo the quadratic D_b equation, every three-double color factor is affine-linear in p=b-12. On the generic fifth-slope locus, welding that remainder to M_5 and M_6 gives an equivalent denominator-free system of four equations in (x,q,d) for each of four rational color packets.
node.notes: Exact equivalence only on alpha!=0. The exceptional x=0 and q=-6x^2 slopes remain in their separately owned finite branches. No generic unit verdict is claimed.
